topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture theme on cancer evolution and outlines the session's key learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Mechanisms of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: Both subtopics examine how cell-intrinsic alterations drive clonal fitness and progression toward malignancy.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: Both subtopics investigate how a cell's position within the normal tissue differentiation hierarchy influences its potential to initiate cancer.

topics.label: Role of the Microenvironment in Tumor Initiation and Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate that tumor initiation and progression require supportive signaling from the surrounding microenvironment.

topics.label: Technologies for Interrogating Tumor-Microenvironment Interactions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the single-cell and spatial profiling methodologies used to map cellular interactions within tumor tissue.

topics.label: Synthesis of the Evolutionary Model of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the lecture's core themes into a unified evolutionary model of cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture Closing and Next Steps
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the topic of the next session.
